title: cache_error
description: Event: a failure raised on the cache read or write path — not only the cache pool itself (e.g. cache server down), but any work the store performs, such as rendering a view or purging a CDN. A cache_miss after this event means the entry could not be read, not that it was never cached.

operation.description: which side of the cache failed: read (the repository get/getDonut call) or write (the put/purge call)

error.description: The throwable message from the failed cache operation

exceptionClass.description: the class of the throwable that failed the operation, so a pool outage is distinguishable from a failure in the work the store performs (rendering, CDN purge)
